x: Good progress was made by a number of youngsters at this distance, notably Steven Garcia, Alistair Grant and Adrian Ross. 800m John Gladwin won the UK Championships at this distance before a pelvic problem affected the heart of his season.

… several encouraging performances that looks good for the future, notably Trevor Blanchard in the long and triple jump, Alistair Grant in the 400H, Gareth Allison who amazes with his talent and versatility, the French twins in the sprints and Joe Minetti who was finding his old form and discovering…

Yet another Belgrave best came from Rob Milner. Even so, he was a little unfortunate as his heat time of 57.31, 8th fastest in the whole of the first round, placed him only 3rd in his race and he had to be content with a performance which erased Alasdair Grant's name from the list.
